transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m here because I’ve been feeling really tired, more than seems normal. I can sleep and I’m still keeping up at work, but I feel like I’m running on a low battery before the day even really starts.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yeah… I’d say so. It’s not like I’m crying all the time, but for a long while now most days have felt kind of gray and flat. Things I used to look forward to—fishing, working on my tomatoes, going to a church concert—they just feel more like tasks to get through than things I actually enjoy.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about two years and four months now. It started around when I got pulled back into full operational leadership, and it’s just kind of stayed with me since then.
Do you still enjoy the things you used to, or has your interest in them decreased over time?

Yeah, my interest has definitely gone down. I still do some of those things, like fishing or messing with the tomatoes, but they don’t feel the same anymore. It’s more like I’m checking them off a list than actually enjoying them. Most days just feel kind of gray and flat.
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to normal since this started?

Not really, no. Since I got pulled back into full operational leadership—about two years and four months ago—it’s pretty much been there. Maybe some days are a little better than others, but I wouldn’t say I’ve felt completely back to normal.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or weight since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, my appetite’s been off more days than not. I’ll work through lunch and not really notice, then at dinner I just kind of pick at my food. My wife’s mentioned my pants are getting looser, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I’m not sure I’d call it anxious. I don’t really feel panicky or anything like that. Maybe tense sometimes, but I haven’t noticed being especially on edge lately.
Do you ever have days where you don't feel sad or down at all?

Maybe a few moments here and there, but not really whole days. Most days there’s this gray, flat feeling. Even things I used to look forward to—fishing, working on the tomatoes, going to a church concert—feel more like something to get through than something I actually enjoy.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?

Not much, honestly. I still do things like fishing or tending the tomatoes, and I’ll go to a church concert if it’s on, but it doesn’t really feel enjoyable the way it used to. It’s more like I’m checking something off a list than actually getting pleasure from it.
Have you had more than one period where you felt this low, or has it been pretty consistent since it started?

It’s been pretty consistent, I’d say. It started when I got pulled back into full operational leadership, and that was about two years and four months ago. Since then it hasn’t really lifted for any real stretch.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in and look forward to?

Not really. I still do those things—fishing, the tomatoes, maybe a church concert—but I don’t really look forward to them like I used to. It’s more like I’m just getting them done, checking them off, and that gray feeling is still there most days.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks where you felt consistently depressed?

Yes. It’s been a lot longer than two weeks. For a long time now I’ve had this gray, flat feeling most days. Even things I used to look forward to, like fishing or tending the tomatoes or going to a church concert, just feel more like items on a checklist than anything I actually enjoy.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy and look forward to?

Not much, no. I still do things like fishing or working on the tomatoes, and I’ll go to a church concert sometimes, but I don’t really look forward to them anymore. It feels more like I’m just checking them off, with that gray, flat feeling still there most days.
Have you had any previous episodes of feeling this low before the one that started two years and four months ago?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a clear earlier stretch like this. I’ve had low days here and there, but nothing that stands out to me the way this one does.
Have you ever felt this low before the episode that started two years and four months ago?
I don’t really think so. I mean, I’ve had rough patches before, like anyone, but I can’t point to a time before this where I felt this low for this long.
Have you had any episodes of feeling this low before the one that started two years and four months ago?
I don’t think I have, no. I’ve had times where I felt down, but not an episode like this that I can remember.
Have you had any episodes of feeling this low before the one that started two years and four months ago?
Not that I can really identify. I’ve been down at different times in my life, but I don’t remember any earlier episode that felt like this one.
Have you had any episodes of feeling this low before the one that started two years and four months ago?
I don’t have a clear example of that, no. I’ve felt down before, but I can’t say there was another episode like this before then.
Have you felt completely back to normal for at least two months at any point since this started two years and four months ago?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been going on pretty steadily since I got pulled back into full operational leadership, about two years and four months ago.
Have you had any episodes of depression like this before the one that started two years and four months ago?
I don’t really think so. I’ve had rough patches before, but nothing I can point to that was like this before it started then.
